description: ESP32-S2 serial behavior vectors, matching the firmware on feature/esp32-controller (3cbea5f). Each case starts from a fresh boot (the boot line itself is listed once in boot_emit) with watchdog_ms and hardware_ceiling unless a case overrides hardware_ceiling (the firmware default ceiling is 0 until physically validated, so harnesses must set it). Each step sends one line (a newline is appended) at t_ms, or advances the watchdog with tick; emit lists the JSON lines expected in response, in order; armed and outputs are the logical (pre-wiring) state afterwards. Duplicate JSON keys are intentionally not covered: the firmware reads the first occurrence and no legitimate sender produces them. Optional per-step accessories {buzzer, light} is the firmware's buzzer/light state afterwards; it is off at boot and changes only on an accepted accessories command.
